updateSalary.description: Updates the salary of an employee (only their boss)
updateSalary.sql: UPDATE employees SET salary = $salary WHERE employeeId = $employeeId

create.description: Creates a new entry in 'employees' (only with a session)
create.sql: INSERT INTO employees(email, password, departmentId, bossId, firstName, lastName, salary, position, isActive) VALUES ($email, $password, $departmentId, $bossId, $firstName, $lastName, $salary, $position, $isActive)

update.description: Updates an existing entry in 'employees' by its primary key (only with a session)
update.sql: UPDATE employees SET email = $email, password = $password, departmentId = $departmentId, bossId = $bossId, firstName = $firstName, lastName = $lastName, salary = $salary, position = $position, isActive = $isActive WHERE employeeId = $employeeId

delete.description: Deletes an existing entry in 'employees' by its primary key (only with a session)
